messages:
Maria G: Quick check — I need to run a temporary probe from CI to our staging model private endpoint (vpce-ml-stg). Can sec confirm egress allowlist and whether we need log redaction for request payloads?
Alex C: Which IP will the probe come from — GH Actions hosted or our self-hosted runner?
Maria G: Self-hosted runner in acct-123. Single IP for the run: 34.78.12.99. One-off test, ~30min.
SecBot: Auto-check: no existing allowlist entry for 34.78.12.99 on vpce-ml-stg. See policy note: inbound to VPCE only via security-group, outbound controlled by route table.
Jonah R: For staging I'd rather do a short-lived allowlist entry or run via bastion. If it's 30m we can add temp rule with expiration.
SRE Ops: Two quick asks: (1) confirm probe doesn't include user PII in payloads, (2) server-side logs must redact request bodies and auth headers. We have a simple redaction rule: replace body with 'REDACTED' in access logs.
Maria G: Confirmed — probe uses synthetic prompts only. Example curl (headers redacted):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"smoke-test-prompt"}' \
  https://vpce-ml-stg.internal/api/v1/generate
```
SRE Ops: Sample VPC flow log line for this path: `ACCEPT eni-0a1b2c3d4e 34.78.12.99 10.0.5.12 443 12345 6 2023-09-12T14:32:00Z`. Treat any request payload captured by app logs as `REDACTED`.
Eva T: I'm OK to approve temporary allowlist for 2 hours with conditions: ephemeral token only, request payloads redacted, and IP removed after window. @Jonah R can you formalize? :white_check_mark:
Jonah R: Opening ticket ENGSEC-4823 with details, will add IP 34.78.12.99 for 2h, note 'staging probe'.
SecBot: Ticket created: https://issuetracker.internal/ENGSEC-4823 — assigned to Jonah R.
Alex C: Thanks team. I'll wait for the ticket to be live before kicking the probe off. @Maria G please post here when done so we can rotate the token. :lock:
